standard_prerequisites.name: Invertible modules over a semi-local ring are free of rank one
standard_prerequisites.use: Turns the invertible section modules into copies of R.

standard_prerequisites.name: The faithful flat descent statement for line bundles with trivial pullback
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies both the invertibility of the section modules and the unit property of st.

core_obligations: Apply the previous lemma to see that M = H^0(X, L) and N = H^0(X, L tensor -1) are invertible R-modules (proof lines 5796-5798).
Use that R is semi-local to obtain isomorphisms M isomorphic to R and N isomorphic to R, and choose generators s and t (proof lines 5798-5800).
Use the last assertion of the previous lemma to see that st is a unit of R, and conclude that s and t give trivializations of L and of its inverse (proof lines 5801-5804).
proof_roadmap: Get invertibility of the two section modules.
Show the product of the generators is a unit and conclude.
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that for a faithfully flat ring map A -> B and a quasi-compact quasi-separated A-scheme whose ring of global sections R is semi-local, an invertible sheaf on X whose pullback to X_B is trivial is already trivial. The proof uses the previous lemma to see that M = H^0(X, L) and N = H^0(X, L tensor -1) are invertible R-modules, applies the structure of invertible modules over a semi-local ring to get M isomorphic to R and N isomorphic to R, chooses generators s and t, and concludes from the last part of the previous lemma that st is a unit, so that s and t define trivializations (proof lines 5796-5804). H2: the reduction from the invertibility statement to an explicit trivialization through generators is the substance, and it is written out.
